instruction: Open the note called "Reading Queue" in Apple Notes and add "Finish the first chapter this week." as a new line at the end.
reference_command:
note_index=$(memo notes | awk '/^[0-9]+\./ { idx=$1; sub(/\./, "", idx); line=$0; sub(/^[0-9]+\. /, "", line); n=split(line, parts, " - "); title=parts[n]; if (title == "Reading Queue") { print idx; exit } }')
if [ -z "$note_index" ]; then
  echo "Note not found: Reading Queue"
  exit 1
fi
cat > /tmp/memo_auto_edit.sh <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
file="$1"

cat > "$file" <<'TXT'
Reading Queue

Books to read
Finish the first chapter this week.
TXT
EOF

chmod +x /tmp/memo_auto_edit.sh
printf '%s\n' "$note_index" | env EDITOR=/tmp/memo_auto_edit.sh memo notes --edit

parameters.note_content: Finish the first chapter this week.
